Definition: to gather grapes; also to be isolated (i.e. inaccessible by height or fortification)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to gather, restrain, fence, fortify, make inaccessible, enclose; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to cut off; 1a2) fortified, cut off, made inaccessible (pass participle); 1a3) secrets, mysteries, inaccessible things (subst); 1b) (Niphal) to be withheld; 1c) (Piel) to fortify
